text:
Maria_CS: Hey team — Northbridge dedicated pool is scheduled for production traffic next Tue 10:00 UTC. Need final quota numbers, autoscale policy, and a load-test dry run slot. Who can own the end-to-end run?
devon_sre: I can lead the dry run. Quick Q: what are peak/sustained targets from the customer?
ajay_csm: Northbridge plan: steady-state ~500 rps, expected peak bursts up to ~1.2k rps for ~5–10m, average tokens/request ~70. They want <200ms p95 for short prompts.
priya_eng: Model variant is redwood-open-13B-quant, seq_len ~512. On our infra that maps to ~75 inference reqs/GPU/s baseline (depends on batching).
devon_sre: Ok that implies ~8–10 GPUs reserved for headroom. I propose reserved_quota=10 and autoscale max=16. Autoscale policy: scale up if p95 latency >180ms for 3 consecutive 20s windows, and scale down if p95 <120ms for 2 minutes. Thoughts?
Maria_CS: Sounds reasonable. Customer asked for graceful fallback to a smaller model if we hit capacity — can we add a traffic-split fallback to redwood-open-3B?
priya_eng: Yes, we can add model-fallback routing in the policy with 10% spillover to 3B when queue depth > 200. We'll simulate in load tests.
leo_oncall: I'm oncall Fri and can be primary for the dry run. Can we schedule a full soak (2h) + burst tests (3x10m bursts) on Friday 09:00 UTC?
ajay_csm: I'll coordinate with customer — Friday 09:00 UTC works for them. They'll provide an API key for test traffic and a proxy endpoint.
devon_sre: I'll put together the k6 scenario. Draft command: `k6 run --vus 600 --duration 30m script.js` then bursts: `k6 run --vus 1200 --duration 10m burst.js`. Script will sample prompt lengths and simulate kv-cache warmups.
priya_eng: Add a pre-warm phase that sends repeated prefix requests to populate KV cache. Something like: `for i in 1..1000: /v1/generate prompt=warmup_${i}`. Otherwise first-token p99 spikes will skew results.
loadbot: smoke: all smoke checks passed on staging (model load, health checks).
devon_sre: Checklist I'm tracking: 1) reserve 10 GPUs in pool (ops) 2) deploy autoscale policy + fallback routing (priya) 3) load test scripts & schedule (devon) 4) customer test endpoint + creds (ajay) 5) oncall coverage & post-run rollback plan (leo). I'll make a Loom of the test procedure and attach results.
Maria_CS: Can we also capture quality metrics during the soak (sampling responses every 5m and running quick eval against 50 golden prompts)? Want to ensure fallback doesn't regress business-critical outputs.
priya_eng: I'll wire a lightweight eval hook to store response diffs in S3 and flag if semantic-similarity drops >0.12 (we use embed cosine).
leo_oncall: Rollback plan: if >3% 5xx or p95 >400ms for >10m, shift traffic to hosted fallback pool and open incident. I'll standby.
ajay_csm: Noted. I'll notify customer of the test windows and RTO expectations. Also asking them to limit non-test traffic during the dry run window.
devon_sre: Final ask — surface the quota allocation in the Console under Northbridge -> Capacity so CS + customer can see reserved vs used. Maria can you confirm permissions?
Maria_CS: Confirmed, I'll ensure Northbridge account has Viewer+Capacity roles and send invite to customer's infra lead.
devon_sre: Great. I'll run a light rehearsal Wed 15:00 UTC (10m smoke + 2 short bursts) to validate scripts. Full dry run Fri 09:00 UTC. Owners set.
Maria_CS: Awesome — thanks everyone. Post-run we'll capture notes and recommend final reserved quota + renewal signal. :thumbsup:
leo_oncall: I'll be available for both runs. :eyes:
ajay_csm: Customer confirmed Friday. Sending calendar invites now.
priya_eng: Pushed the fallback routing PR to staging. Link in case needed: https://git.internal/r/northbridge/fallback (test-only).
devon_sre: Copy. I'll share the k6 scripts in the runbook channel shortly.
Maria_CS: Closing loop — owners: devon (dry run + results), priya (fallback + eval hook), leo (oncall), ajay (customer comms). We'll reconvene after the run for final quota recommendation.
Maria_CS: Thanks all! :party:
